label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — user input from request header flows through URL decoding, inner class transformation, concatenation with TESTFILES_DIR constant, and reaches the response sink via encodeForHTML(fileName). Per balanced encoding rule, attacker-controlled data reaching the sink through encoding warrants TP. Alert 2 (java/path-injection): alert-TP — same user input flows through identical chain and reaches new File(fileName) sink without sanitization, enabling path traversal. Both alerts have attacker-controlled resolved sink values.

evidence.note: XSS sink: response.getWriter().println() outputs encodeForHTML(fileName) where fileName derives from user header
Path injection sink: new File(fileName) uses unsanitized fileName containing user input from header
